platform: Cloud-backed SaaS and web platform with Android/iOS apps and Teachmint X classroom hardware; no documented on-premise deployment.

distinctive_features.feature: EduAI content generation integrated with Teachmint X classroom hardware
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Teachers can create lessons, quizzes, homework, summaries and explanations within the classroom workflow.
Administrators can monitor device activity, manage apps and settings, and coordinate updates across connected panels.

distinctive_features.feature: Camera-based face-recognition attendance on Teachmint X
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Automates attendance capture while allowing teachers to review and correct recognition results.
Enables live whole-class quiz participation and provides response and accuracy insights.
Provides access to Google services and Play Store apps within an enterprise-oriented classroom device.

distinctive_features.feature: NCERT-mapped Hindi and English digital content with offline materials
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Helps Indian schools align classroom resources to familiar curricula and use content with limited connectivity.
Turns board-result text files into Excel performance reports for school analysis.

weaknesses.issue: Standalone admissions and fee-management modules are no longer available, creating procurement and migration risk for ERP buyers.
Current software prices, implementation fees and enterprise limits are not publicly listed and require sales engagement.
No public API documentation, marketplace or verified OneRoster, LTI, Ed-Fi, SIF, Clever or ClassLink support.
Reviewers report crashes, slow response, unresolved support requests and friction using support tickets.
Users report limited customization, rigid reports and confusing editing workflows.
Apple reviewers report broken layouts and test-upload friction; some users also request dark mode.
India-specific reporting such as UDISE+, APAAR, NEP holistic progress cards and state-board templates is unverified.
DPDP readiness, SOC 2, FERPA and COPPA certifications are not documented; schools must verify contractual safeguards.

ai_features: EduAI lesson-plan, quiz and homework generation
Class recaps, summaries and mind maps
AI tutor and lecture question-answering features
pricing_model_summary: Software pricing is quote-based and not publicly listed. Teachmint X panels have published hardware prices; app purchases include optional subscriptions and AI-tutor purchases.
biggest_strategic_gap: The product is repositioning toward connected classrooms while core ERP modules such as standalone admissions and fees are discontinued and interoperability and compliance remain weakly documented.
